scope: Read the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations. Compared dates, category and award-cycle terminology, historical context, and outbound links; treated first-person contribution claims as author statements.
findings: Corrected the Japanese headline typo and wording typo; clarified that this is a July 2023 historical award report in every edition.
Removed the duplicate 2026 date, kept the original 2023-07-31 publication date, and set lastmod to 2026-11-24.
Replaced the retired MSDN forum destination with Microsoft's migration notice, labeled the forums read-only, and updated Twitter references to X (formerly Twitter).
Added a link to Microsoft's current official MVP program overview.

post/Microsoft MVP受賞について(2023-2024)/inde.summary: Compared the complete translation with the Japanese source; verified the award year, seven-year claim, historical time frame, and updated reference links.

meaning.note: The article is clearly framed as a July 2023 first-person account of the 2023-2024 award, and the seven-consecutive-year claim is preserved.

terminology.note: Microsoft MVP and Developer Technologies retain their official names; the former MSDN forum is labeled read-only and X is identified as formerly Twitter.

mathematics.note: The article contains no mathematical claims.

code.note: The article contains no executable code.

links.note: GitHub, X, Microsoft's MSDN migration notice, and the current official MVP program page are linked.

limitations: AI-assisted review; no human or native-speaker certification.
The award and activity statements are the author's first-person account and were not independently verified.
Microsoft's current MVP overview is a JavaScript application; the link is an official program entry point.
